name: How many replacement properties can I identify in a 1031 exchange?

mainEntity.name: How many replacement properties can I identify in a 1031 exchange?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can identify multiple replacement properties, typically following one of two rules: the Three Property Rule or the 200% Rule. The Three Property Rule allows you to identify up to three properties regardless of their fair market value. The 200% Rule allows you to identify any number of properties, provided their aggregate fair market value does not exceed 200% of the relinquished property's value. Understanding these rules is crucial, as exceeding them can invalidate your identification. Kelby Contreras can guide you through selecting and identifying properties within these parameters.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can identify up to three properties (Three Property Rule) or any number of properties whose total value is not more than 200% of the relinquished property's value (200% Rule).
